Franklin Crypto Index ETF to Add HYPE Holdings on December 1 According to an SEC filing, the Franklin Crypto Index ETF will add Hyperliquid (HYPE) to its holdings on or around December 1. Its underlying index, the CF Institutional Digital Asset Index, will add HYPE on December 1, bringing its constituents to BTC, ETH, XRP, SOL, DOGE, ADA, XLM, and HYPE. The ETF will allocate assets according to their index weights, with the index continuing to rebalance quarterly. — link

Nvidia Agrees to $290M Settlement Over Crypto Mining Revenue Disclosures According to Reuters, Nvidia has agreed to pay $290 million to settle an investor class action lawsuit filed in 2018. The plaintiffs alleged that Nvidia misled investors by attributing rapid growth in gaming-related revenue to gaming demand rather than cryptocurrency mining, understating the contribution of crypto miners to its GPU sales. Nvidia denied any wrongdoing, and the proposed settlement remains subject to court approval. Plaintiffs’ lawyers plan to seek up to $62 million in legal fees, representing 21.4% of the settlement fund. — link

Braiins Confirms Bitcoin Mining Share Hijacking, Warns of Stratum V1 Security Risks Bitcoin mining pool Braiins confirmed that attackers have exploited the lack of pool authentication in unsecured Stratum V1 connections, redirecting mining shares to attackers while miners continue operating normally. In one incident, more than 1,000 mining sites lost their pool connections within the same second. Braiins warned that miners using unsecured Stratum V1 are vulnerable regardless of their mining pool and recommended securing all primary and backup connections using Stratum V2 or TLS with pool identity verification. — link
